placements.title: From blocking extraction to receipt-then-watch
placements.frame: How does this expression hand extraction off so the client never waits, and so no work is lost if the client drops the receipt?
placements.why: The graph has no existing leaves or strata, so nothing is reusable. The three segments share one subject: remember should return immediately, extraction should run asynchronously and be watched by polling, and no work should be lost. src-1 reports the ratified contract, src-2 states its non-blocking and no-loss properties, and src-3 gives the dispatch sequence (poll the run or receive the reaction on a later call). This is a durable theme that future envelopes on async delivery will keep feeding, not a one-time fact, so it is minted as a leaf. No strata tier is minted, because only one standalone leaf is produced here.
consulted: STRATA REFERENCE: Product/ProductLadder and Architecture/SystemTopology considered as possible regions; the theme is delivery mechanics rather than a named organizational category, so no region is set
